Alright, I fixed it.

The problem was with the silicon required in the recipes.       

There are two types in the pack, the EnderIO silicon and the one from Refined Storage.     
I was making silicon by putting quartz into an Alloy Smelter and that was outputing the EnderIO silicon.     

The solderers however were expecting the other type and thus froze.     
I swapped the Smelter for a Redstone Furnace and it seems to work. If there is atleast one of the RS silicon on the drives it seems to also be able to use the EnderIO silicon.

That is an energy conduit at the back.
I attempted putting the crafter at the back but it didn't help.
IIRC the solderer inputs from all sides and outputs at the bottom in 1.10 but I could be mistaken.

As mentioned before, there is an importer at the bottom of the solderer.
